resources.assets:6452.description: Peasants equipped with clubs. Not an enemy to worry about, unless they appear in bigger numbers.

resources.assets:5068.name: E Archer
resources.assets:5068.description: Archers shoot arrows from afar. Quite strong when left uncontested. Weak against buildings and towers.

resources.assets:6451.name: E Ogre
resources.assets:6451.description: Ogres are huge melee warriors that really pack a punch. Hey! Due to their human heritage, ogres aren't monsters though (everybody knows that, duh).

levels.tooltip: Unlock more build options and choose an upgrade.

choice.name: Royal Training
choice.tooltip:
+ 75% HP for your character
+ 75% Overall damage output for your character

choice.name: Builder's Guild
choice.tooltip:
+ Every morning a level 1 house is automatically upgraded to a level 2 house (if available)
+ 50% HP for your character

choice.name: Magic Armor
choice.tooltip:
+ Enemies that deal damage to you take a part of that damage themselves
+ 150% HP for your character

choice.name: Assassin's Training
choice.tooltip:
+ If you manage to execute your weapon's special ability precisely when its last cooldown expires, the next cooldown is greatly reduced
+ 100% Overall damage output for your character

levels.tooltip: Unlocks the option to build fields to increase income.

choice.name: Improved Plow
choice.tooltip: Every future upgrade of the mill will increase its income even more (+1/Upgrade)

choice.name: Explosive Trap
choice.tooltip: The mill explodes when destroyed dealing massive damage around itself. The damage and radius increase every time you upgrade this mill.

choice.name: Scarecrows
choice.tooltip: Every field belonging to this mill receives a free scarecrow. Scarecrows have a strong anti-air attack.

choice.name: Wind Spirits
choice.tooltip: Wind spirits magically intercept a portion of enemy arrows in the range of the mill. Every future upgrade of the mill improves this effect.
